featured_reviews.review_translated_text: On September 5, 2021, I went to C Wing in Parijat Society located in Bandra Reclamation. Earlier, the security guards were alert at the main gate. They took note as per the rules. I noticed that the lift in C Wing was out of order. So I climbed the stairs to the sixth floor. Otherwise, there was peace everywhere. I hope that once the possibility of a third wave of Covid becomes clear, then this terrible peace will end and a happy atmosphere will be created everywhere.
